property_summary: Executing seedMarket must set initialized to true, causing getFreeKilo to revert before seedMarket is called.
After seedMarket executes, initialized must be true if and only if marketDrugs is nonzero.
The ceoAddress can only be changed when called by the current ceoAddress.
Only the current ceoAddress can change ceoAddress via DrugDealer.
The function DrugDealer should only succeed when called by the current ceoAddress.
DrugDealer() reverts if and only if the caller is not the current ceoAddress.
DrugDealer() reverts if and only if the caller is not the current ceoAddress.
Only the current ceoAddress can change ceoAddress. The mutant allows any caller to become ceoAddress, so a non-CEO caller changing ceoAddress yields a different ceoAddress than the original.
After any sequence of calls, the ceoAddress can be changed only if the caller is the current ceoAddress; the mutant allows anyone to become ceoAddress.
After any call to DrugDealer(), the ceoAddress must either remain unchanged or be set to msg.sender only if msg.sender is the previous ceoAddress; the mutant allows any caller to become ceoAddress.
